summary:
Davros, Dalek Creator is a drain-and-discard deck that rewards opponents losing 3+ life each turn. This review re-verifies all fifteen items of the deck's rules attestation.

Key rule: Davros's condition is checked on resolution, not an intervening if, so end-step drains ordered above it count. Entropic Battlecruiser turns discard choices into life loss. No list errors.

interactions.title: The 3-life check is on resolution, not an intervening if
interactions.ruling: Davros's 'if an opponent lost 3 or more life this turn' comes after the effect, not right after the trigger condition, so it isn't an intervening-if clause. Davros always triggers at your end step and checks the turn's life-loss history on resolution. So end-step drains (Perforating Artist, Wound Reflection, Missy) ordered above Davros still count.
interactions.short: Always triggers at end step; the 3-life condition is checked on resolution.

oracle.quote: At the beginning of your end step, create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace if an opponent lost 3 or more life this turn.

source.item: Davros end-step trigger and 3-life qualification timing

interactions.title: Villainous choices resolve player by player
interactions.ruling: Each qualifying opponent faces 'you draw a card, or that player discards a card'. With several opponents, the first in turn order chooses and that option is carried out before the next player chooses. A player may pick either option even if it's impossible (discarding from an empty hand).

rulings.quote: If a spell or ability requires multiple players to face a villainous choice, the result is a little different from other effects in Magic. In that case, the first player in turn order makes their choice and the action for that choice is performed before the next player makes their choice.
A player facing a villainous choice can always choose either option, even if one or both of the options are impossible.

interactions.title: Order end-step drains above Davros
interactions.ruling:
Perforating Artist (raid), Wound Reflection and Missy also trigger at the beginning of your end step. Put Davros on the stack first and the others on top so they resolve first:
- **Wound Reflection:** doubles each opponent's life lost so far, so someone who lost 2 has now lost 4.
- **Perforating Artist:** each opponent loses 3 unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard (and a discard triggers Battlecruiser).
- **Missy:** each artifact creature deals 1 damage, or you draw and chaos ensues.

Then Davros resolves with more opponents qualifying.
interactions.short: Put Davros's trigger on the stack first so the drains resolve before it.

rulings.quote: When Wound Reflection's ability resolves, it checks how much life each opponent lost over the course of the turn, then it causes that opponent to lose that much life.

interactions.title: Copying and doubling Davros
interactions.ruling:
Several cards repeat Davros's trigger; each instance resolves separately and checks life loss when it resolves:
- **Scientist Supreme (once per turn, your turn) and Strionic Resonator:** copy it, because Davros is an artifact.
- **Roaming Throne:** naming Alien or Scientist adds a separate trigger.
- **Auton Soldier:** as a nonlegendary artifact copy of Davros, it has its own trigger.

oracle.quote: {2}, {T}: Copy target triggered ability you control.

interactions.title: The Valeyard doubles every villainous choice
interactions.ruling: Whenever an opponent would face a villainous choice, The Valeyard makes them face it an additional time; they can choose differently. This doubles Davros's, Missy's, The Dalek Emperor's and Genesis of the Daleks chapter IV choices.

oracle.quote: If an opponent would face a villainous choice, they face that choice an additional time.

interactions.title: Entropic Battlecruiser at station 1+ punishes discards
interactions.ruling:
With at least one charge counter, Battlecruiser makes each opponent who discards lose 3 life. It doesn't need to be a creature for that; it becomes an artifact creature at 8+. Station is sorcery speed: tap another creature, add counters equal to its power.

This turns 'or discard' options into 3 life:
- Court of Ambition's upkeep 'unless they discard'.
- Davros's own discard option.
- Geier Reach Sanitarium's draw-then-discard on your turn, which also qualifies opponents for Davros.

oracle.quote: 1+ | Whenever an opponent discards a card, they lose 3 life.

source.item: Court of Ambition + Entropic Battlecruiser at station 1+
Geier Reach Sanitarium + Entropic Battlecruiser at station 1+

interactions.title: Fixed 3-life enablers
interactions.ruling: Maestros Charm's drain mode (each opponent loses 3, you gain 3) and Loyal Subordinate (beginning of combat, if you control your commander: each opponent loses 3) each qualify every opponent for Davros that turn.

oracle.quote: Lieutenant — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control your commander, each opponent loses 3 life.
Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.

interactions.title: Labyrinth Raptor and menace Daleks
interactions.ruling: Davros and the Dalek tokens have menace. When one becomes blocked, Labyrinth Raptor makes the defending player sacrifice a creature of their choice that's blocking it. {B}{R} gives all your menace creatures +1/+0.

oracle.quote: Whenever a creature you control with menace becomes blocked, defending player sacrifices a creature of their choice that's blocking it.

interactions.title: Commander tax; Loyal Subordinate needs Davros out
interactions.ruling: Davros costs {1}{U}{B}{R}, then 6, then 8. Loyal Subordinate checks that you control your commander at beginning of combat, so it's off while Davros is in the command zone. Davros is an artifact creature, so artifact copy effects (Scientist Supreme, Auton Soldier) apply.
